recognize_zh: 油鏡下 CD117 在細長紡錘形細胞呈強烈、顆粒狀的細胞質與膜陽性，細胞沿同一方向排列，核呈卵圓至細長形，符合非典型紡錘形肥大細胞。
features: Elongated spindle-shaped cells with oval to elongated nuclei
Strong granular cytoplasmic and membranous CD117 staining outlining cell processes
Cells aligned in a streaming parallel arrangement
Occasional round positive cells with central nuclei
Intermixed CD117-negative cells with blue nuclei
describe_en: CD117 immunostain at oil immersion shows numerous elongated spindle-shaped cells with strong granular cytoplasmic and membranous staining, arranged in a streaming pattern. The nuclei are oval to elongated with fine chromatin. Admixed negative cells are present. Findings are consistent with atypical spindled mast cells, a morphologic minor criterion (>25% spindled/atypical mast cells) of systemic mastocytosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are round to oval with central nuclei and are scattered rather than spindled and aggregated, and are CD25-negative.
GIST cells are CD117+ spindle cells but are DOG1+ and tryptase-negative.
